source_issue.title: Update the Plone image tags automatically

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need to automatically update Plone image tags in `values.yaml` and `appVersion`. Currently, Dependabot does not handle these updates. The goal is to utilize Renovate or set up a scheduled workflow to create pull requests when a new release of `plone-backend`, `plone-frontend`, or `plone-zeo` occurs.

## What needs to be done
1. Choose between implementing Renovate or creating a scheduled workflow.
2. Ensure that the updates to image tags in `values.yaml` and `appVersion` are automated.
3. Follow the dependencies of this issue, specifically Issue #26.

## Helpful background
Image tags are labels that identify specific versions of software containers. They are crucial for maintaining compatibility in multi-component systems like Plone. Understanding how image tagging and pull requests work will be beneficial for this task.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the Plone repository, especially the `values.yaml` file and current workflows.
2. Explore the documentation for Renovate and GitHub workflows to see how to implement automated updates.
3. Engage with the community if you have questions—asking for clarification on any unclear points can provide valuable insights. 

Feel free to reach out to the issue author, [ericof](https://github.com/ericof), if you need guidance!
